audit.kind: captured device DBI plus matching installed scheduler
limitations: DBI rows describe logical contiguous source segments, not physical HBM transactions.
First-record K offsets are corroborated separately using completed native-binary simulation.
Allocated M=16 must not be confused with the MMAD runtime M field.
Same-shape native F.linear probe is audited; the real-model profile has no 160-byte launch payload.
l2_cache_flag is not treated as an effective bypass policy: the matching scheduler code is commented out.
Four public GSM8K questions; not a 128-question accuracy re-evaluation.
Independent service launches; physical weight addresses not controlled identical.
V2 changes one natural output trajectory; throughput is not an identical-work comparison.
Small aggregate differences from one timing pass do not establish a stable throughput gain.
Device probe uses synthetic BF16 weights and a full distinct physical working set.
Simulator timestamps are not actual device latency; v2 single-core runs verify instructions only.
V1/V2 change arithmetic order; V3 preserves bitwise output in the tested operator cases only.
Only matched whole-model performance and output checks determine adoption.
